# Munea (沐寧)

> Munea is an AI health companion app for iPhone (iOS 15 or later), made for the whole family, available on the App Store in Taiwan, the United States, Canada and Japan. Older parents talk with an AI companion by voice and get medication and check-up reminders; adult children who live far away join a family health circle to see how their parents are doing. Munea is a companion and reminder tool. It is not a medical device and not a long-term care system.

Also known as: 沐寧, Munea App, 沐寧 App, Munea 沐寧 (all the same app).

Brand line (Traditional Chinese original): 家人的健康，終於有人一直記得。 ("Finally, someone remembers your family's health.")

## Who it is for

- Adult children (often 40-60) who worry about parents living alone or far away.
- Older adults who want someone to talk to and help remembering medicine and doctor visits.
- The whole family, connected in one family health circle.

## What it does

- Voice conversation with an AI companion (characters named Ningning 寧寧 and Mumu 沐沐 in Chinese; Nina and Milo in English). Munea is voice-only: there is no typed text chat.
- The companion remembers what you shared before and picks up where you left off.
- Medication and check-up reminders, delivered as phone notifications even when the app is closed. Munea only reminds; it never evaluates or changes medication.
- With permission, health data from Apple Health (steps, heart rate, blood oxygen, blood pressure, sleep) shown at a glance.
- Family health circle: family members in the same family health circle can see health and mood updates, and can play small games together (walking challenge, quiz).
- The companions are AI: illustrated characters with AI-generated voices. They say plainly that they are AI and never pretend to be human or a family member.

## Pricing

- Free to download. New accounts get 5 trial credits (1 credit is about 1 minute of conversation). The free plan covers the account owner only; currently every member of a family health circle needs a Plus or Pro plan.
- Plus: 100 credits per month, family health circle of up to 4 people (including the owner).
- Pro: 200 credits per month, up to 12 people (including the owner).
- App Store prices as of November 2026: Taiwan Plus NT$599/month (NT$5,750/year), Pro NT$1,199/month (NT$11,500/year); United States Plus US$19.99/month (US$199.99/year), Pro US$39.99/month (US$399.99/year); Japan Plus ¥3,500/month (¥30,000/year), Pro ¥6,000/month (¥60,000/year). The price shown in the app is what you pay.
- Extra credits can be purchased. Subscriptions auto-renew through the App Store and can be canceled anytime.

## Privacy principles

- Voice is encrypted and processed in the cloud only to understand what the user says.
- Munea does not store raw audio recordings separately; only key points of conversations are saved so the companion can remember. Users can view or delete them in the app ("My data").
- Data is never sold, never shared with data brokers, and never used for advertising.
- Only members of the family health circle see status and summaries; full transcripts are not shown by default.

## What Munea does not do

- Not a medical device. No diagnosis, prescriptions, or treatment advice.
- Not an emergency service: no fall detection, no SOS button, no location sharing, and it does not alert family when the person has not opened the app. In an emergency, contact local emergency services.
- No Android version (iPhone only).
- Not a long-term care system, and not a replacement for doctors, pharmacists, or caregivers.
- Designed not to give medical advice and to say when it is not sure; like any AI it can still be wrong.

## 繁體中文簡介

沐寧（Munea）是 iPhone 上的 AI 健康照護管家 App，給全家人一起用。長輩可以用語音跟 AI 陪伴角色（寧寧、沐沐）聊天，她會記得你說過的近況，並到點提醒用藥與回診；在外地的子女加入全家健康圈，就看得到爸媽的健康與心情近況。沐寧只有語音聊聊，沒有打字聊天。

收費：下載免費，註冊送 5 點體驗（1 點約可聊 1 分鐘）。Plus 每月 100 點、全家健康圈最多 4 人；Pro 每月 200 點、最多 12 人。台灣價格 Plus 每月 NT$599、Pro 每月 NT$1,199，另有年繳；其他地區以 App 內顯示為準。

隱私：語音加密傳到雲端處理，沐寧不另外保存原始錄音，只留對話重點，可在「我的資料」查看或刪除；資料不販售、不用於廣告；只有全家健康圈裡的家人看得到。

不做的事：沐寧不是醫療器材，不做診斷、不開藥、不提供治療建議，也不是緊急服務。
